The PSNR in dB against the sharp image. Both images are 160 by 160 pixels, blurred with the Gaussian PSF of sigma 2 and the reflect border, with Gaussian noise of sigma 5 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. The lambda columns use 100 iterations. The last column uses the default lambda of 3 and 300 iterations, which still gains, so 100 iterations stop short of the minimum. The disks are flat shapes, which total variation suits, so they gain more than the fine spokes of the star.
